title: Canada Pivots to EU, India and China Amid 'Revolutionary Change' in US Foreign Policy
detail: Analysts describe Canada's pivot toward the EU, India and China as a sign of 'revolutionary change in American foreign policy', with longstanding US alliances and trade relationships rapidly reordering as Canada seeks new economic and diplomatic partners in response to US tariff pressure and shifting commitments.

title: Supreme Court Rejects Trump Bid to Restrict Mail-In Ballots via Postal Service
detail: The US Supreme Court rejected the Trump administration's attempt to use the Postal Service to restrict mail-in ballots, issuing a significant ruling as midterm early voting begins. The decision is a setback for the administration's efforts to limit mail voting ahead of the November 2026 midterms.
